description: SSOT for all opacity token values used by interactive states. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-opacity-disabled.role: Disabled opacity — disabled buttons, inputs, controls

TK-opacity-hover.role: Hover overlay opacity — hover state darkening

TK-opacity-focus.role: Focus overlay opacity — focus ring visibility

TK-opacity-pressed.role: Pressed overlay opacity — active/pressed state darkening
